items.title: Report the Hawaii County GET surcharge
items.description: Hawaii's Department of Taxation lists a 0.5% Hawaii County surcharge on the 4% general excise and use tax. Report the surcharge on Forms G-45 and G-49; businesses operating in more than one county also file Form G-75.
items.deadline: On the assigned Hawaii general excise tax filing schedule

note: Hawaii County GET surcharge is confirmed by the Hawaii Department of Taxation; county TAT and other county-level duties were not checked.
